rationale: ADR 0053 grows the representation-gap ledger, whose owner column holds one citation record per cited work unit; EXTRACTION-REPRESENTATION-GAPS.24.a took the registry to 62 of 64 records while it used 10,121 of 32,768 bytes. At its real mean of about 160 bytes a record, the unchanged byte bound funds about 200 records, so max_records rises to 128 and max_bytes stays; the registry's coherence (max_records x max_record_bytes) is LIVE-DOCUMENT-PRESSURE-HEADROOM.36d's class question and is not changed here.
